nodes.title: Modular building assembly (read me first)
widgets_values:
Modular buildings: first build a kit (each piece 4 m wide, one storey 3.5 m tall), then place the kit by rules onto every building's facades - the deliverable is **the kit meshes + an instance table**, not a lump of merged buildings.

Kit (the four left columns): Wall_Plain / Wall_Window / Wall_WindowPair / Wall_Door / Wall_Shopfront / Wall_Balcony / Corner_Pillar / Roof_Cornice / Roof_Flat / Roof_Unit / Roof_Tank / Roof_Penthouse (a stair core). Convention: pivot at the midpoint of the bottom edge (rooftop plant: on the roof surface), outer facade facing +Z, wall thickness towards −Z; each piece's primitives have a material attribute (M_Wall / M_Trim / M_Glass / M_Door / M_Metal / M_Roof / M_RoofFlat / M_Sign), exported as glTF material slots; the facade column of the table swaps M_Wall for M_BrickBuff or M_Stucco per building (a material override); UVs are a world-scale box projection (1 UV = 1 m), the same density as the material library (pcg_prod_material_library, one image = 1 m); all seven slots point to the material library's images by relative path in the glb - run the material library first and the kit opens textured.

Assembly (right side):
① On a 4 m grid, rules mark out the footprints of 12 buildings in the four quarters of two crossing 16 m streets (L shapes, slabs, a 14-storey tower, small houses), merged into outlines, each with its own number of floors. The rules wrangle's spare parameters: Layout 1 generates the block instead (lots of 12-20 m frontage with lanes between, Density, Min / Max Floors -- taller toward the crossing --, Seed for another block); Layout 0 is the table above.
② The outlines are extruded floor by floor, each side face is a 4 m × 3.5 m slot; slot centre → point (with outward normal).
③ Rules: shopfronts on the main street's ground floors, on the side street only near the crossing (further on, entrances and windows); towers of 9+ floors stand on a two-storey podium (the first floor shopfront too); upper floors take a random piece per "column" (lined up vertically); one balcony style per building (none, scattered on even floors, or bands on every third floor); a cornice ring above the top floor, roofs tiled per cell, rooftop plant, and a stair core on buildings of 8+ floors; pillars at the outer wall corners.
④ Instance table (CSV, with bld / floor / facade columns) + one glb per kit piece (SM_Kit_*.glb) holding LOD0, LOD1 (the small parts stripped, at 40 m) and a convex UCX collision hull, with a .lods.json beside it.
⑤ Preview (right column): Copy to Points by name places the kit back, weathered per building (tint, grime at the foot, curtains, dark and lit windows); the streets get curbs, paving, road paint, manholes, lamps, benches, bins, bus shelters, traffic lights, lane and park trees (Tree Generator with leaf cards) and parked cars; context blocks (whole-bay facade texture, tinted per district, rooftop clutter) fill the distance; an aerial, an eye-level shot, and the aerial again at dusk (the windows and lamps lit).
⑥ The block again under pcg/city as a world: the kit glbs in assets/, a 1024 m tile's instance table, and a World.json (World Manifest) that engine/unreal and engine/unity import; its city key names the facade materials (the importers place the pieces, the facade swap is left to the project).

nodes.title: World-scale box projection (1 UV = 1 m, same density as the material library)
LOD1: without the small parts (faces < 0.1 m²)
LOD Create: LOD0 the piece, LOD1 the stripped piece (switch at 40 m)

a = detail(1, "value")                # the piece this iteration (Block Begin's value)
s@asset = a
s@name = sprintf("UCX_%s_00", a)
# a slot the piece already has (engines ignore the collision's material; the glb keeps its slot set)
s@material = where(a == "SM_Kit_Roof_Flat", "M_RoofFlat", where(a == "SM_Kit_Roof_Unit", "M_Metal",
    where(a == "SM_Kit_Roof_Tank", "M_Roof", where((a == "SM_Kit_Corner_Pillar") | (a == "SM_Kit_Roof_Cornice"),
    "M_Trim", "M_Wall"))))

b = where((x >= -22) & (x <= -10) & (z >= 26) & (z <= 38), 9, b)

fa = 0 * x
fa = where(b == 0, 1, fa)
fa = where(b == 2, 2, fa)
fa = where(b == 3, 1, fa)
fa = where(b == 4, 2, fa)
fa = where(b == 7, 2, fa)
fa = where(b == 8, 1, fa)
fa = where(b == 9, 2, fa)
fa = where(b == 10, 1, fa)
# ── a generated block (Layout 1)
layout = chi("layout", 0)
sd = chi("seed", 1)
dens = ch("density", 0.85)
fmin = max(1, chi("min_floors", 3))
fmax = min(14, max(fmin, chi("max_floors", 12)))
def hh(a):
    v = np.sin(np.asarray(a, np.float64) * 12.9898 + sd * 78.233 + 0.5) * 43758.5453
    return v - np.floor(v)
ax = np.abs(np.asarray(x))
az = np.abs(np.asarray(z))
q = (np.asarray(x) > 0) * 1 + (np.asarray(z) > 0) * 2
u = np.floor((ax - 8) / 4)              # cells out from the street along x
v = np.floor((az - 8) / 4)              # and along z
lot = np.full(ax.shape, -1.0)
dl = np.zeros(ax.shape)
lane = np.zeros(ax.shape, bool)
for qq in range(4):
    wu = [3 + int(hh(qq * 101 + k * 7.3) * 3) for k in range(12)]      # frontages: 3-5 cells
    wv = [3 + int(hh(qq * 211 + k * 5.1) * 2) for k in range(12)]      # depths: 3-4 cells
    cu = np.cumsum(wu)
    cv = np.cumsum(wv)
    m = q == qq
    iu = np.searchsorted(cu, u[m], side='right')
    iv = np.searchsorted(cv, v[m], side='right')
    lot[m] = qq * 1000 + iu * 20 + iv
    lane[m] = (u[m] == cu[iu] - 1) | (v[m] == cv[iv] - 1)            # the last cell of a lot: a lane
    su = np.concatenate([[0], cu])[iu]
    sv = np.concatenate([[0], cv])[iv]
    dl[m] = np.sqrt((8 + 4 * su + 8) ** 2 + (8 + 4 * sv + 8) ** 2)
on = (ax > 8) & (az > 8) & ~lane & (hh(lot * 0.37 + 0.11) < dens)
near = 1 - np.clip((dl - 14) / 46, 0, 1)
gf = np.clip(np.round(fmin + (fmax - fmin) * near * near * (3 - 2 * near) + (hh(lot * 1.7) - 0.5) * 4), fmin, fmax)
gfa = np.floor(hh(lot * 2.3 + 0.9) * 3)
ids = np.unique(lot[on])
gb = np.where(on, np.searchsorted(ids, lot), -1)
b = where(layout == 1, gb, b)
f = where(layout == 1, np.where(on, gf, 0), f)
fa = where(layout == 1, np.where(on, gfa, 0), fa)
i@bld = where(b < 0, -1, b)
i@floors = where(b < 0, 0, f)
i@facade = fa

widgets_values:
fl = floor(@P.y / 3.5)
i@floor = fl
@P.y = fl * 3.5                      # pivot at the midpoint of the bottom edge
t = normalize(cross(set(0, 1, 0), @N))
col = floor(dot(@P, t) / 4 + 0.5)    # which column on the facade (aligned vertically)
face = floor(dot(@N, set(1.3, 0, 2.9)) * 10 + 0.5)
h = rand(col * 7.31 + @bld * 13.7 + face * 0.37)
ox = @P.x + 2 * @N.x                 # 2 m in front of the facade
oz = @P.z + 2 * @N.z
main = abs(oz) < 8                # facing the main street (it runs along x)
side = abs(ox) < 8                # facing the side street
street = main | side
# shops: all along the main street; on the side street only near the crossing (within 24 m of it)
shop = main | (side & (abs(@P.z) < 24))
win = where(@facade == 2, "Wall_WindowPair", "Wall_Window")   # render facades: paired windows
# one balcony style per building: 0 none, 1 scattered on even floors, 2 bands (every street column, every third floor)
bs = floor(rand(@bld * 5.31 + 1.7) * 3)
bal = street & (fl >= 1) & (((bs == 1) & (h > 0.55) & (fl % 2 == 0)) | ((bs == 2) & (fl % 3 == 2)))
# towers (9+ floors) stand on a two-storey podium: the first floor is shopfront too where the ground floor is
podium = (@floors >= 9) & (fl == 1) & shop
up_ = where(podium, "Wall_Shopfront", where(bal, "Wall_Balcony",
            where((h < 0.12) & (bs != 2), "Wall_Plain", win)))
# ground floor: shops; the rest of the side street gets entrances and windows; the backs doors and plain walls
ground = where(shop, "Wall_Shopfront", where(street, where(h > 0.6, "Wall_Door", win),
               where(h > 0.78, "Wall_Door", "Wall_Plain")))
s@name = where(fl == 0, ground, up_)
@up = set(0, 1, 0)
nodes.title: Rules: which piece goes in each slot

widgets_values:
h = rand(@ptnum * 3.17 + 0.5)
big = @floors >= 5
# the stair / lift core: on buildings of 8+ floors, the roof cell nearest the building's middle
b = np.asarray(@bld).reshape(-1).astype(int) + 1
px = np.asarray(@P.x).reshape(-1)
pz = np.asarray(@P.z).reshape(-1)
n_ = np.bincount(b, minlength=b.max() + 1).astype(float)
mx = np.bincount(b, px, b.max() + 1) / np.maximum(n_, 1)
mz = np.bincount(b, pz, b.max() + 1) / np.maximum(n_, 1)
d = (px - mx[b]) ** 2 + (pz - mz[b]) ** 2 + np.asarray(rand(@ptnum * 0.73)).reshape(-1) * 1e-3
dm = np.full(b.max() + 1, 1e9)
np.minimum.at(dm, b, d)
stair = (d == dm[b]) & (np.asarray(@floors).reshape(-1) >= 8)
s@name = where(stair, "Roof_Penthouse", where(big & (h < 0.035), "Roof_Tank", where(h < 0.14, "Roof_Unit", "")))
# random quarter turns, and (plant only) a little slack inside the 4 m cell
a = floor(rand(@ptnum * 1.91) * 4) * 1.5708
@N = set(sin(a), 0, cos(a))
k = where(stair, 0.0, 1.2)
@P.x += (rand(@ptnum * 2.3) - 0.5) * k
@P.z += (rand(@ptnum * 4.1) - 0.5) * k

widgets_values:
b = @bld
# every building its own shade (brighter or darker, warmer or cooler)
br = 0.88 + 0.24 * rand(b * 3.7 + 0.1)
hh = rand(b * 5.1 + 0.3) - 0.5
tint = set(br * (1 + 0.10 * hh), br, br * (1 - 0.10 * hh))
# dirt: splashed up the foot of the wall, and a little over the lower floors
grime = (1 - 0.30 * (1 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.6, @hy))) * (0.90 + 0.10 * smoothstep(0.0, 14.0, @hy))
gk = @gk
glass = where(gk < 0.22, set(1.30, 1.15, 0.98), where(gk < 0.40, set(0.55, 0.56, 0.60), set(1, 1, 1)))
@Cd = where(@wk == 1, tint * grime, where(@wk == 2, glass * sqrt(grime), @Cd))
# about a third of the windows lit at dusk, warm, each its own brightness
lit = (@wk == 2) & (gk > 0.45) & (gk < 0.80)
@emit = set(1.6, 1.05, 0.55) * where(lit, 0.6 + rand(gk * 91.3), 0.0)
# the texture shifted per building
@uv = @uv + set(floor(rand(b * 2.3 + 0.7) * 8), floor(rand(b * 7.1 + 0.2) * 8) + rand(b * 1.9))
